title: Form domination and tent space estimates for operators on the half-space
summary: We study operators acting on functions defined on the half-space, with methods inspired by sparse domination. Using the specific link between dyadic grids on the boundary and Whitney regions on the half-space, we obtain a very precise form domination with model operators of Hardy type. We introduce mixed-norm off-diagonal estimates that measures both tangential and transversal decay without requiring pointwise control in the transversal variable, substantially weakening the assumptions used in earlier tent space theories.
